name: Tommy Gun
operating_principle: The Thompson M1928A1 submachine gun operates on the blowback principle, where the breech is not locked and the cartridge is fired by the recoil of the bolt. The Blish lock, a friction-based locking system, helps to delay the opening of the breech.

components.description: The barrel group consists of the barrel and the compensator.
The bolt and bolt carrier group includes the bolt, bolt carrier, and associated components.
The receiver and dust cover house the bolt and bolt carrier group, and provide a mounting point for the barrel and other components.
The fire control group includes the trigger, sear, and other components that control the firing of the weapon.
The feed system includes the magazine and magazine catch, and is responsible for feeding cartridges into the weapon.
The furniture includes the stock, grip, and other components that provide a comfortable and stable platform for the shooter.
The sights include the rear sight and other components that provide aiming references for the shooter.
The recoil/return spring assembly includes the recoil spring and other components that help to return the bolt to its forward position after firing.
